enum.name: ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS
enum.description: Status flags of ADUM_GPS_PVT. Combine with bitwise OR; each flag qualifies one part of the message.

entry.name: ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_TIME_VALID
entry.description: time_usec holds a valid UTC date and time. If clear, time_usec is 0 and must not be used to set any clock.

entry.name: ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_DIFF_CORRECTIONS
entry.description: Differential (RTK) corrections were applied to this solution. Set for DGPS, RTK float and RTK fixed; clear for a standalone solution.

entry.name: ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_HEADING_VALID
entry.description: heading_motion is valid. If clear, ignore heading_motion (it is typically unreliable at very low speed).

enum.name: ADUM_ARMING_STATUS
enum.description: Arming state of the flight controller, as sent in ADUM_AUX_CHANNELS.

entry.name: ADUM_ARMING_STATUS_DISARMED
entry.description: Disarmed. The satellite board must not drive the motors (servos may still be driven, as the flight controller commands).

entry.name: ADUM_ARMING_STATUS_ARMED
entry.description: Armed. The motor values are valid commands.

message.name: ADUM_GPS_PVT
message.description: Position, velocity and time (PVT) solution streamed by the ADUM GPS-RTK module to the flight controller. One message carries a complete, self-consistent solution for a single GNSS epoch. Direction: GPS-RTK module -> flight controller.
message.field: UTC time since the UNIX epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) of this solution. Valid only if ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_TIME_VALID is set, otherwise 0.
Latitude (WGS84), positive north. Degrees multiplied by 1e7.
Longitude (WGS84), positive east. Degrees multiplied by 1e7.
Altitude above mean sea level (geoid), positive up. Equals alt_ellipsoid minus the geoid separation at this position.
Altitude above the WGS84 ellipsoid, positive up.
Velocity over ground, North component (positive north).
Velocity over ground, East component (positive east).
Velocity over ground, Down component (positive down, so a climb is negative).

Heading of motion (course over ground): direction of the velocity vector, 0..359.99999 degrees clockwise from true North, multiplied by 1e5. This is NOT the vehicle's attitude heading. Valid only if ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_HEADING_VALID is set.
Horizontal position accuracy estimate, as reported by the GPS receiver.
Vertical position accuracy estimate, as reported by the GPS receiver.
Speed accuracy estimate, as reported by the GPS receiver.
Position dilution of precision, scaled by 100 (1.23 is sent as 123). UINT16_MAX if unknown.

Fix type (GPS_FIX_TYPE). Values: 0 NO_GPS No GPS connected. 1 NO_FIX GPS connected, but no position information. 2 2D_FIX 2D position (no usable altitude). 3 3D_FIX 3D position, standalone. 4 DGPS 3D position aided by DGPS / SBAS. 5 RTK_FLOAT RTK solution with float carrier-phase ambiguities (decimetre-level). 6 RTK_FIXED RTK solution with fixed carrier-phase ambiguities (centimetre-level). 7 STATIC Static fixed position, typically used on base stations. 8 PPP Precise Point Positioning, 3D position. Only 3 and above give a usable 3D position. ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS_DIFF_CORRECTIONS is set for 4, 5 and 6.
Number of satellites used in the solution. UINT8_MAX if unknown.
Status flags (ADUM_GPS_PVT_FLAGS bitmask): 1 TIME_VALID time_usec is valid. 2 DIFF_CORRECTIONS differential (RTK) corrections applied. 4 HEADING_VALID heading_motion is valid.

message.name: ADUM_MAGNETOMETER
message.description: Magnetometer measurement from a sensor to the flight controller. Same content as the INAV MSP2_SENSOR_COMPASS packet (instance, time, X/Y/Z in mGauss). Direction: sensor module -> flight controller.
message.field: Sensor instance index, 0 for the first magnetometer.
Timestamp of the measurement (milliseconds, in the sender's own time base).
Magnetic field, X axis, pointing to the front of the vehicle.
Magnetic field, Y axis, pointing to the right of the vehicle.
Magnetic field, Z axis, pointing down.

message.name: ADUM_AUX_CHANNELS
message.description: Actuator outputs computed by the main INAV flight controller, for the satellite board that drives the motors and servos. Contains the arming status, then motors 1-3, then servos 1-8. Direction: flight controller -> satellite board.
message.field: Arming status (ADUM_ARMING_STATUS): 0 DISARMED Motors must not be driven. 1 ARMED Motor values are valid commands.
Motor 1-3 output, as the INAV motor[] value (pulse width in microseconds). Index 0 is motor 1.
Servo 1-8 output, as the INAV servo[] value (pulse width in microseconds). Index 0 is servo 1.
